| Sport | Number of Students |
| :--- | :--- |
| Hockey | 60 |
| Football | 180 |
| Tennis | 120 |
| Basketball | 120 |

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.

output.answer: Draw lines from the center to all eight points on the circle. Moving clockwise from 12 o’clock, label the sector from 12 to 1:30 **Hockey**, from 1:30 to 6 **Football**, from 6 to 9 **Tennis**, and from 9 to 12 **Basketball**.

The categories break down like this: hockey takes up 1/8 (60), football 3/8 (180), tennis 1/4 (120), and basketball also 90.
